adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` within the updated `updateAllCalendarEvents` flow (the new loop over `calendarReference`), when a reference has `credentialId` but it is not found in `this.calendarCredentials`, the code now does `prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: reference.credentialId } })` and constructs a `credential` from that record, then calls `updateEvent(credential, ...)`. The diff shows no validation that the fetched credential belongs to the booking’s organizer/user/team (e.g., matching `userId`/`teamId`). Previously, the logic only used `this.calendarCredentials` (implicitly scoped to the current context). This introduces a real ownership/authorization risk if an unexpected `credentialId` exists in the booking references.
